generation_meta_data.title: BUG: Evaluation button does not show results on UI
generation_meta_data.description: When users click the evaluation button, nothing happens — no results are displayed. Investigation shows the button was not bound to any action handler, so the evaluation process never triggers the UI update.
generation_meta_data.resolution: Fixed by binding the evaluation button to the proper action handler so it triggers result tab creation.

thread.message: The UI feels sluggish when too many tabs are open. We should brainstorm ways to speed up rendering.
Agreed. Most of the slowness comes from uncontrolled tab creation. Every feature seems to spawn a new tab.
What if we enforce a whitelist for tab creation? Only core features like 'new file', 'file upload', and 'saving' can create new tabs.
That sounds reasonable. Evaluation, search, and other secondary features could reuse an existing workspace view instead of opening tabs.
Exactly. I'll draft a TabPolicy implementation that blocks non-whitelisted features from opening new tabs.
Great — if we get this right, it should cut rendering cost by a lot. Let’s test it after rollout to ensure nothing critical breaks.

generation_meta_data.author: bob
generation_meta_data.message: perf(ui): limit new tab creation behind TabPolicy; whitelist ['newFile','upload','save']

generation_meta_data.description: Adopt TabPolicy-based restriction on new tab creation to reduce render cost.

generation_meta_data.message: Team, I believe there’s a UI bug: when a customer clicks the Evaluation button, the results do not show.

replies.message: Yeah, I’ve noticed the same thing. Roughly 1 out of 3 clicks actually opens the results — other times, nothing happens.
Confirmed on my side too. It feels random — sometimes the results tab appears, sometimes not. Looks like a race condition or a missing tab creation.
Let’s dig deeper. The evaluation *does* run in the backend, but the UI doesn’t always show the results. Could be tied to how the tab creation logic works.
